fact: A results workshop at Aného on 10 January 2024 reported that the project for systematic birth registration in the four communes of the Lacs prefecture, financed by the French embassy in Togo through its decentralisation support programme, modernised the central civil status offices with computer equipment and a software tool and set up civil status desks in delivery centres.
title: Lacs / projet d’enregistrement systématique des naissances : les résultats partages aux acteurs clés
